name: Toast
summary: Slice of golden toast with butter, jam or nothing on it, for breakfast and café scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the slice stands on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~380 px tall); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: spread
params.note: butter = melting butter pat; jam = berry jam; none = plain toast

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = small rock, pop = scale in with overshoot

author: krakujs
